author: MiniMax Agent
description: Retail investor assistance tool using probability thinking and strict risk control to help establish proper investment discipline. Suitable for retail investors who want to learn systematic investment methods, control losses, and build probabilistic advantages.

can_do: Provide high-probability signals based on historical data screening
Help establish investment discipline and probabilistic thinking
Identify partial characteristics of main player disguised behaviors
cannot_do: Precisely predict stocks that will rise on day 2 or 3
Eliminate all losses (62% win rate still means 38% probability of loss)

name: retail-investor-pro

core_insights: Dragon Tiger List publishes at T+1 day 18:00, cannot be used for T+1 day 9:30 trading
Institutions can disguise signals, historical data cannot predict the future
No free Token can provide real-time main player behavior data
Positive expected value does not equal actual profit, need to deduct slippage and impact costs
Consecutive losses are inevitable, psychological preparation required
socrates_validation.framework_boundary: Probabilistic advantage system, not prediction machine
